description: Chilmark Shopping Center is a well-established neighborhood shopping destination located at 1856-1924 Pleasantville Road in the prestigious community of Briarcliff Manor, New York. Spanning 46,786 square feet, this conveniently located center serves the surrounding affluent residential neighborhoods with essential retail and services. The property is anchored by CVS Pharmacy, providing prescription services and everyday necessities to the local community. With approximately 1 million annual visits, Chilmark Shopping Center has become an integral part of the daily lives of Briarcliff Manor residents. Managed by Regency Centers, a nationally recognized shopping center developer and operator, the property benefits from professional management and strategic positioning within a thriving Westchester County market. The center's location in Briarcliff Manor, surrounded by quality single and multi-family homes, ensures a stable customer base of discerning shoppers who appreciate accessible, neighborhood-oriented retail.
